payload.scope: Environment importance sampling and per-lobe MIS for the material runtime
payload.cpu: Full MSVC and clang-cl rendering regression passes 351 tests and 454018 checks. Two independent reviewers confirm the production sampling math and the deterministic sequence regression.
payload.gpu: Nine R2 normal-entry material scenes pass 168 frames with zero validation errors; a separate hidden 3840x2160 target passes 12 frames. R3 differs by two comment spellings and has byte-identical runtime text and all 32 shaders.
payload.quality: Same-binary, same-input HDR readback reduces 24 isolated bright samples to zero across 31052 interior pixels. RMS to the 512/256/128 NDF reference falls from 0.09136585 to 0.03211194. The actual alias buffer and six source cube faces match CPU bytes.
payload.correction: The initial midpoint sequence produced an always-zero alias coin for a 24576-entry table. Deterministic stratified jitter fixes this production-sequence defect; original failure evidence is preserved.
payload.build_placement: Three clean R2 builds and one fixed executable verify input invalidation, shader update, exact rollback and malformed-shader rejection. Current index hashes and the R2/R3 comment-only delta remain explicit.
payload.remaining: Signed-candidate CI and main readback follow. Parent Issue 1343 remains open for full M4 completion, GI, geometry, temporal quality, physical 4K output and Unreal Engine comparison.
